Recurrent spontaneous abortion in females with Turner syndrome is a known complication due to the lack of ovarian function and associated cardiac anomalies. The combination of these features suggests a strong association between skewed X-inactivation and recurrent abortion.
rnj1_8b.critical_evidence: The presence of both recurrent spontaneous abortion and skewed X-inactivation in the same patient supports the diagnosis of Turner syndrome.
